title: Common providers: Greece
coverage: Partial. Complete for the three national operators (fixed and mobile) and the research network; fibre newcomers, regional operators and business ISPs are thin, and the regulator's register was not read.
missing: Smaller and regional ISPs (the regulator's register of providers was not found on the pages read)
The fibre networks of the power utility PPC (no trading name or AS number was confirmed)
An AS number for HCN (none confirmed), so it is not listed
Websites for Telekom and OTEGlobe (each answered an automated request only with a refusal or a bot check on the read date)
Names in Greek script, except the two found on the providers' own pages

sources.name: EETT (Hellenic Telecommunications and Post Commission)
sources.terms: Terms of use: reproduction is allowed for personal or non-commercial use with the source named: nothing is copied.
sources.result: The front page answered on the read date; the register of providers was not found on it. It is the authority to consult for operators this pack lacks.

sources.name: Wikipedia: Internet in Greece
sources.terms: CC BY-SA 4.0. Used to cross-check names only (facts); no text is copied.
sources.result: 3 of 9 candidate names were found on the page (the name as listed; other names of an entry were not looked up).

sources.name: Wikipedia: Telecommunications in Greece
sources.terms: CC BY-SA 4.0. Used to cross-check names only (facts); no text is copied.
sources.result: 1 of 9 candidate names were found on the page (the name as listed; other names of an entry were not looked up).

sources.name: Each provider's own public website
sources.terms: Only the address itself is recorded (a fact); no content is copied.
sources.result: 7 of 9 websites answered one plain automated request; an address that did not answer, or that refused it, is left empty. No support or status page was checked. An address that answered only with a refusal, a bot check or a page-not-found page counts as one that did not answer.

sources.name: RIPEstat as-overview (RIPE NCC)
sources.terms: The RIPEstat terms forbid redistributing RIPEstat data: nothing is copied. Consulted to confirm, for each AS number, that the registered holder is the named provider.
sources.result: 11 AS numbers confirmed; a number whose registered holder was another company or an unrelated name was left out.

sources.name: RIPE Database full-text search (RIPE NCC)
sources.terms: The database terms were not read on the read date: nothing is copied. Searched by company name to find candidate AS numbers; each was then confirmed as the entries above and below say.
sources.result: Candidate numbers found for some providers; none was taken without the confirmation.

sources.name: NRO delegated statistics (the regional registries' joint list of assigned AS numbers)
sources.terms: Published by the registries for public use; only which registry holds each AS number is taken (a fact).
sources.result: Every AS number in the pack was found in the list; its registry is recorded beside it.

sources.name: Wikidata
sources.terms: CC0 1.0: no conditions. The item id of a provider is recorded as a stable cross-reference.
sources.result: 2 entries carry the id of their own Wikidata item; each item states one of the entry's AS numbers (property P3797). A parent group's item is not used.

sources.name: Deutsche Telekom: COSMOTE TELEKOM becomes Telekom
sources.terms: Cited for a date and a name (facts); no text is copied.
sources.result: Read on the date above (release of 3 September 2026): the trading name of the OTE group became Telekom, complete on 8 September 2026.

providers.name: Telekom

providers.name: Nova

providers.name: Inalan
